title: A reminder at the right time
hook: Could a savings reminder matter even without adding money?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Separate attention to a savings goal from a subsidy or higher return.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Separate attention to a savings goal from a subsidy or higher return.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: A toy saver can deposit €10 on four occasions but misses two. With no interest, how much is saved? Toy inputs A=[10, 4, 2, 0]; B=[10, 4, 0, 0].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[20, 2, 0], [40, 0, 0]]. Labels: Saved €, Missed, Interest %.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: The two cases change missed actions while holding deposit size and return fixed. A reminder mechanism can affect attention without being a subsidy. Whether a real reminder changes those actions remains an empirical question.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Deposit €=10, Opportunities=4, Missed=0, Interest %=0. What is Saved €? Answer: 40.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Deposit €=10, Opportunities=4, Missed=0, Interest %=0. What is Saved €?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 40. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: Simple text reminders raised savings about 6% in three countries (Karlan, McConnell, Mullainathan & Zinman, 2016).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Separate attention to a savings goal from a subsidy or higher return.
